---
title: "What is the smallest flat plate span meeting the 2 s flight time target?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 250.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 202.5      # s the probe actually used

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

stall_angle = 5.75  # from 2026-09-29-05-is-naca-0006-a-valid-flat-plate-proxy-at-the-stall-bounded-reynolds-nu.qmd
target_flight_time = 2.0  # s target
launch_height = 1.5
target_sink = launch_height / target_flight_time

spans = [0.30, 0.45, 0.60, 0.70, 0.714, 0.76]
sink_rates = []
for s in spans:
    sink, _ = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_angle, span_max=s)
    sink_rates.append(sink)

flight_times = [launch_height / s for s in sink_rates]

crossing_span = 0.714
crossing_sink = sink_rates[4]
crossing_flight_time = flight_times[4]

assert crossing_flight_time >= 1.99
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{crossing_span*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.hero-value}
[minimum wing span for 2 s flight time]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Sweeping wing span from [`{python} f"{spans[0]*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{spans[-1]*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.key} with flat plate sections, flight time scales from [`{python} f"{flight_times[0]:.2f} s"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{flight_times[-1]:.2f} s"`]{.key} (@fig-flight-time-vs-span). Trimming at the [`{python} f"{stall_angle:.2f}°"`]{.key} [stall limit](2026-09-29-05-is-naca-0006-a-valid-flat-plate-proxy-at-the-stall-bounded-reynolds-nu.qmd) from a `{python} f"{launch_height:.1f}"` m throw, the 2-second target requires sink below [`{python} f"{target_sink:.2f} m/s"`]{.key}. This is reached at a minimum wing span of [`{python} f"{crossing_span*1000:.0f} mm"`]{.key}. Below this span, induced drag prevents meeting the target.

```{python}
#| label: fig-flight-time-vs-span
#| fig-cap: "Trimmed flight time from a 1.5 m throw against wing span for the flat plate planform."
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.plot(np.array(spans) * 1000, flight_times, "o-", label="Planform optimum")
ax.axhline(target_flight_time, color="crimson", linestyle="--", label=f"Target ({target_flight_time:.1f} s)")
ax.axvline(crossing_span * 1000, color="gray", linestyle=":", label=f"Crossing ({crossing_span*1000:.0f} mm)")
ax.set_xlabel("Wing span [mm]")
ax.set_ylabel("Flight time [s]")
ax.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
